section_summary.extract_value: This Results section describes an exploratory factor analysis of the 15-item CEMS (Childhood Eating Messages Scale) conducted on 238 participants. Using parallel analysis, two factors were retained: Pressure to Eat Messages (PEM) with 5 items accounting for 33.69% of variance, and Restrictive and Critical Messages (RCM) with 5 items accounting for 26.64% of variance. The final 10-item CEMS was used in subsequent analyses.
